1a.problem: 1. (20 נק') סעיף א (10 נק'): הראו כי לכל x in [0, pi/2] מתקיים  sin^2(x)/2 <= ln(1+2 sin^2 x) <= 4x.
1a.official_solution:
Right inequality ln(1+2 sin^2 x) <= 4x: let h(x)=4x - ln(1+2 sin^2 x). h(0)=0 and h'(x)=4 - (2 sin 2x)/(1+2 sin^2 x). Since |2 sin 2x| <= 2 and 1+2 sin^2 x >= 1, the subtracted term is <= 2, so h'(x) >= 2 > 0; h is increasing and h(0)=0, hence h >= 0 on [0, pi/2].
Left inequality sin^2(x)/2 <= ln(1+2 sin^2 x): let g(x)=ln(1+2 sin^2 x) - sin^2(x)/2. g(0)=0 and g'(x)= sin 2x*(2/(1+2 sin^2 x) - 1/2). On [0, pi/2], sin 2x >= 0 and 1 <= 1+2 sin^2 x <= 3, so 2/(1+2 sin^2 x) >= 2/3 > 1/2, making the bracket >= 0; thus g' >= 0, g increasing, g(0)=0, hence g >= 0.
1a.notes: Both bounds follow from a monotonicity argument (define the difference, check the endpoint at 0, sign the derivative). Endpoints must be checked and the derivative bounds justified for full credit.

1b.topic: integral inequality by integrating a pointwise bound
1b.problem: 1. סעיף ב (10 נק'): הראו כי  1/3 <= integral_0^{pi/2} sin(x) * ln(1+2 sin^2 x) dx <= 4.
1b.official_solution:
On [0, pi/2] sin x >= 0, so multiply the inequality of part (a) by sin x and integrate over [0, pi/2]:
 integral_0^{pi/2} (sin^3 x)/2 dx <= integral_0^{pi/2} sin x ln(1+2 sin^2 x) dx <= integral_0^{pi/2} 4x sin x dx.
Lower bound: integral_0^{pi/2} sin^3 x dx = 2/3, so the left side = (1/2)(2/3) = 1/3.
Upper bound: integral_0^{pi/2} 4x sin x dx = 4[ -x cos x + sin x ]_0^{pi/2} = 4(0 + 1) = 4.
Therefore 1/3 <= I <= 4.
1b.final_answer: 1/3 <= integral_0^{pi/2} sin(x) ln(1+2 sin^2 x) dx <= 4.
1b.notes: Key step is multiplying part (a) by sin x >= 0 (preserves the inequality) then evaluating integral sin^3 x = 2/3 and integral 4x sin x = 4 by parts.

2a.topic: statement of the Intermediate Value Theorem
2a.problem: 2. (15 נק') סעיף א (5 נק'): נסחו את משפט ערך הביניים.
2a.official_solution: Intermediate Value Theorem: if f is continuous on the closed interval [a,b], then for EVERY value t between f(a) and f(b) (i.e. every t with min(f(a),f(b)) <= t <= max(f(a),f(b))) there exists a point c in [a,b] such that f(c)=t.
2a.final_answer: For every t between f(a) and f(b) there exists c in [a,b] with f(c)=t (f continuous on [a,b]).
2a.notes: The universal quantifier 'for EVERY t between f(a) and f(b)' is part of the statement. Stating it for a single unspecified t is imprecise and costs 1-2 pts of 5, not all of it.

2b.topic: number of real roots via even symmetry and monotonicity
2b.problem: 2. סעיף ב (10 נק'): מצאו את מספר הפתרונות של המשוואה  x^2 + x sin(x) + cos(x) = 0.
2b.official_solution: Let f(x)=x^2 + x sin x + cos x. Then f'(x)=2x + (sin x + x cos x) - sin x = 2x + x cos x = x(2+cos x). Since 2+cos x > 0 for all x, f'(x) < 0 for x<0 and f'(x) > 0 for x>0, so x=0 is the global minimum. f(0)=cos 0 = 1 > 0, hence f(x) >= 1 > 0 for all x and the equation f(x)=0 has NO real solutions.
2b.verify_method: sympy: f'(x)=x(cos x+2), f(0)=1 is the global minimum, f>=1>0 -> 0 real roots
2b.notes: KEY VERIFIED (sympy): x^2 + x sin x + cos x = 0 has 0 real solutions (f(0)=1 is the global minimum, f>=1>0). Do NOT change this final_answer; a nonzero final count contradicts the verified key and loses the conclusion credit. Calibration anchors from the graded booklet: (a) fully correct argument and count 0 -> 10/10; (b) correct final count 0 with an incorrect derivative line (x(2-cos x) written for x(2+cos x) -- the sign slip happens not to change the sign analysis, both factors being positive) plus a loose 'at most 2 roots' middle step -> exactly 7/10: deduct 3 for the incorrect intermediate work, NOT more, when the method and conclusion are otherwise sound; (c) a nonzero final count -> lose the conclusion credit (about half).

3.problem: 3. (15 נק'): חשבו את sqrt(12) ברמת דיוק של 1/100. פתחו פולינום טיילור לפונקציה f(x)=(x+9)^{1/2} סביב x=0 והציבו x=3 (שכן sqrt(12)=sqrt(3+9)).
3.notes: The x^2 coefficient must include the 1/2! factor: f''(0)/2 = -1/216 (a common error is writing -1/108). Second order is required and sufficient for accuracy 1/100; computing higher derivatives than needed is unnecessary (no deduction on its own). Calibration anchors from the graded booklets: (a) a fully correct evaluation reaching T2(3) = 3 + 1/2 - 1/24 = 83/24 with a valid remainder bound is 15/15 even when the write-up is untidy -- do NOT hunt for errors that are not on the page; (b) an evaluated value that contradicts the student's own polynomial (e.g. writing 1/12 where -x^2/(2!*108) at x=3 gives 9/216 = 1/24, i.e. substituting as if the 2! were absent) is a major computational error in the final deliverable: exactly 9/15, and the feedback must name the inconsistent line.

tf1.topic: limit of an alternating partial sum
tf1.official_solution: The partial sum equals -n/2 for even n and (n+1)/2 for odd n; divided by n^2 it tends to 0, not 2/3.
tf1.notes: All-or-nothing; based only on the circled answer.

tf2.problem: נכון/לא נכון (3 נק'): קיים x0 > 0 כך שלכל x > x0 מתקיים  x^{0.000001} > ln(x).
tf2.official_solution: For any eps>0, x^eps / ln x -> inf as x -> inf, so eventually x^{0.000001} > ln x. The statement is true.
tf2.notes: All-or-nothing; based only on the circled answer.

tf3.topic: subsequence conditions do not force convergence
tf3.problem: נכון/לא נכון (3 נק'): אם lim_{n->inf} a_{4n+1} קיים ו- lim_{n->inf} (a_{4n+1} - a_{4n+2}) = 0, אזי הסדרה {a_n} מתכנסת.
tf3.official_solution: Only the subsequences a_{4n+1} and a_{4n+2} are controlled; the terms a_{4n} and a_{4n+3} are unconstrained, so {a_n} need not converge (choose them to oscillate). The statement is false.
tf3.notes: All-or-nothing; based only on the circled answer.

tf4.topic: an inflection point can also be an extremum
tf4.problem: נכון/לא נכון (3 נק'): נקודת פיתול יכולה להיות גם נקודת מינימום.
tf4.official_solution: True. Example: f(x)=x^2 for x<=0 and f(x)=sqrt(x) for x>0 has a (global) minimum at 0, while the concavity changes there (convex on the left, concave on the right), so 0 is both a minimum and an inflection point.
tf4.notes: All-or-nothing; based only on the circled answer.

tf5.problem: נכון/לא נכון (3 נק'): אם f גזירה מימין בנקודה a אזי היא רציפה מימין בנקודה a.
tf5.official_solution: True. If the right derivative exists then lim_{x->a+} (f(x)-f(a)) = lim (f(x)-f(a))/(x-a) * (x-a) = f'_+(a) * 0 = 0, i.e. f is right-continuous at a.
tf5.notes: All-or-nothing; based only on the circled answer.

mc1.problem: אמריקאי (7 נק'): הגבול של הפונקציה  lim_{x->0} ( sin(x)/x )^{ x / ln(1+x) }  הוא: א. -inf  ב. 2  ג. 1  ד. inf  ה. 0.
mc1.official_solution: Base sin x / x -> 1, exponent x/ln(1+x) -> 1. With L the limit, ln L = lim (x/ln(1+x)) * ln(sin x / x) = 1 * 0 = 0, so L = 1. The correct answer VALUE is 1.

mc2.problem: אמריקאי (7 נק'): נתונים I = sum_{n=2}^inf sin^2( pi/2 - arctan n )  ו-  II = sum_{n=1}^inf tan(1+1/n)/ln(1+1/n). אזי: א. I מתכנס II מתבדר  ב. II מתכנס I מתבדר  ג. שניהם מתכנסים  ד. שניהם מתבדרים.
mc2.official_solution: sin(pi/2 - arctan n) = cos(arctan n) = 1/sqrt(1+n^2), so I = sum 1/(1+n^2) converges. In II the terms tend to tan(1)/ln(1+1/n); since ln(1+1/n) ~ 1/n -> 0 and tan 1 != 0, the terms ~ n tan 1 -> inf, so II diverges. The correct answer CONTENT is: I converges and II diverges.
mc2.notes: All-or-nothing. Option LETTERS are shuffled between printed forms of this exam — grade by matching the CONTENT of the circled option to this answer, never by letter.

mc3.topic: interval of convergence of a power series
mc3.problem: אמריקאי (7 נק'): הטור  sum_{n=1}^inf ln(n) (x-1)^n  מתכנס עבור ה-x-ים הבאים: א. 0<=x<=2  ב. 0<=x<2  ג. 0<x<=2  ד. -inf<x<inf  ה. 0<x<2.
mc3.official_solution: Radius: limsup ln(n)^{1/n} = 1, so R = 1 and |x-1| < 1, i.e. 0 < x < 2. At both endpoints the general term ln(n)(+-1)^n does not tend to 0, so the series diverges there; the interval is open. The correct answer CONTENT is the OPEN interval 0 < x < 2 — an option including either endpoint (0 <= x or x <= 2) is WRONG.
mc3.final_answer: The open interval 0 < x < 2 (both endpoints excluded).
mc3.notes: All-or-nothing. Option LETTERS are shuffled between printed forms of this exam — grade by matching the CONTENT of the circled option to this answer, never by letter.

mc4.problem: אמריקאי (7 נק'): נתונה פונקציה רציפה f:[0,1]->[0,1]. אזי: א. קיימת c ב-[0,1] כך ש- f^2(c) tan(c+1) = c  ב. ... f(c)+1 = c  ג. ... f(sin c) = c  ד. ... f(c) ln(c+3) = c  ה. ... e^c f(c) = c.
mc4.official_solution: The TRUE statement is: there exists c in [0,1] with f(sin c) = c. Proof: let g(c)=f(sin c) - c. g(0)=f(0) >= 0 and g(1)=f(sin 1) - 1 <= 0 (since f <= 1); by the IVT there is c in [0,1] with f(sin c) = c. Every other offered statement can fail (e.g. the constant function f == 1 breaks the f(c)+1=c, f(c)ln(c+3)=c and e^c f(c)=c variants).
mc4.final_answer: The statement: there exists c in [0,1] with f(sin c) = c.
mc4.notes: All-or-nothing. Option LETTERS are shuffled between printed forms of this exam — grade by matching the CONTENT of the circled option to this answer, never by letter.

mc5.problem: אמריקאי (7 נק'): ערך האינטגרל  integral_1^e dx / ( x * (ln x)^{0.5} ): א. 4  ב. 3  ג. 2  ד. 1  ה. 0.
mc5.official_solution: Substitute u = ln x, du = dx/x: integral_0^1 u^{-1/2} du = [ 2 sqrt(u) ]_0^1 = 2. The correct answer VALUE is 2.
